scope: Actual30development findings inform policy, not acceptance/classifier/sourcewide filtering. No automatic body transformation in this overlay.

rules.defect: Absent equations/operands/variable labels/graphs or essential figures
rules.action: Hold complete dependent explanation/exercise unit. Reacquire or compare exact source-native math/figure/caption/alt-text under separately bound rights/transport; preserve full original and source-supported replacement/inverse. Never infer mathematical values or answers from context.

Hold containing authored whole unit until exact dependency recoverable. Preserve intact adjacent prose with its section/component ancestry only under explicit dependency resolution, not arbitrary sentence crops.
Exact upstream edition comparison needed; no generic word-deletion or language-model correction. Preserve authored abridgements/ellipsis and component notices.

rules.defect: Glossary terms absent but main exposition intact
rules.action: Separate glossary component with exact spans and dependency sidecar; retain whole main exposition only if independent from missing terms; preserve all originals and inverse. This is an engineering proposal, not current repair execution.

rules.defect: Resource catalogs, verse, lists or code
rules.action: Source role remains explicit. Preserve semantic reference/procedure lists and mixed explanation/code; do not blanket blacklist topic/code/shortness or remove list items. Catalog/verse cannot silently count as continuous exposition; separately review intended mixture role.

rules.defect: Historical numbers, legal/medical/scientific or controversial claims
rules.action: Separate version/factual risk and scope-specific primary verification; date alone does not establish falsity. Preserve source wording/credits; no factual rewrite from assumptions.

rules.defect: Delivery site differs from upstream author/work
rules.action: Maintain original/OpenStax/translation/edition/component attribution and family custody; PressBooks hosting is not distinct provenance diversity. Unclear rights/ancestry remain holds independent of readability.

classification_caution: A current-representation review hold is not a major-corruption finding or proof that all sections are unusable. Minor typos or ordinary figure references alone do not justify whole-source exclusion. Anthology plot remains readable; preserve complete coherent authored sections, with explicit source spans and note dependencies, under independently reviewed source-supported component rules. No arbitrary fragments or topic bans.
